WITH updated_drink AS ( UPDATE drinks
drink_name = #{drinkName}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = #{status}, drink_category_id = #{drinkCategoryId},
shop_id = #{shopId},
WHERE drink_id = #{drinkId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
AND shop_id = #{shopId}
AND 1 = 0
RETURNING drink_id )
UPDATE drink_details SET price = #{price} WHERE drink_id IN (SELECT drink_id FROM updated_drink) AND size = #{size};
